specimens.label: Inaugural globe and spear emblem
specimens.locator: 1964–65 full-time calendar cover, PDF p. 1; embedded JPEG, not native vector
specimens.note: BCIT Photography dates first use to 1964. The separately prepared research reconstruction is an approximation, not the original or a gallery holding.
specimens.rightsNote: No permission to rehost this scan or the research reconstruction was verified. BCIT Photography marks its separate archival colour specimen all rights reserved.

specimens.label: Upright outlined BCIT acronym
specimens.note: The outline is already visible in the 1972–73 calendar. The research reconstruction uses the 1978–79 cover, not that earlier witness; it omits the cover’s decorative lines and is not original artwork.
specimens.rightsNote: The archive credits BCIT copyright. The scan and research reconstruction are not hosted by this gallery.

specimens.label: BCIT 20th-anniversary emblem
specimens.note: The tricolour anniversary device appears alongside the upright outline logo, not as its replacement. The invitation is dated September 14, 1984; the source article was published in 2014.

specimens.label: Italic striped acronym without a swoosh
specimens.locator: 1986–87 full-time calendar cover, PDF p. 1; corroborated by later covers
specimens.note: Calendar use continues through 1991–92, and the 1993–94 cover still shows the standalone form. Do not infer a universal replacement date or reuse 2007 contours for this earlier form.

specimens.label: Striped acronym with orbital swoosh
specimens.locator: BCIT Update issue 6, PDF p. 1; new-logo notice p. 4; 400-ppi archival scans
specimens.note: The dated issue shows the swoosh in use. BCIT separately claimed use since at least November 1992 in trademark record 1014344; the claim is not an independently dated specimen.

specimens.label: Coat of arms, supporters, flag and badge
specimens.locator: Public Register, vol. III, p. 93; grant of February 29, 1996
specimens.note: BCIT’s heraldic grant is not a phase in the logo sequence. The Canada Gazette announcement followed on November 23, 1996.
specimens.rightsNote: The Authority requires permission from both the grantee and the Authority for reproduction.

specimens.label: Outgoing Eras full-name lockup
specimens.locator: BCIT Update physical PDF p. 1, printed p. 12, upper example; 97 fills and 2 strokes, no raster or live text
specimens.note: The born-digital article shows this as outgoing, not first introduced in 2007. The existing striped acronym and swoosh were kept.

specimens.label: Incoming Trade Gothic full-name lockup
specimens.locator: Same issue and page, lower example; 38 fills, 2 strokes and 36 embedded Trade Gothic glyphs
specimens.note: The private extract used the original embedded glyph outlines. This is a change to the lockup typography, not an adoption date for the swoosh.

specimens.label: Early 2017 visual identity refresh
specimens.locator: Year in Review 2016–17, printed p. 14 / PDF p. 16
specimens.note: The institute reports an early-2017 reveal and new positioning. A January trademark filing is separate evidence, not an exact public launch date. A 2014 anniversary lockup already used a blue square, so the 2017 refresh does not establish the square’s first appearance.
